build_jasco_solver: build a JASCO solver instance from a DictConfig to train text-to-music generation models
run_jasco_training_step: run a single training step on an audio batch with the JASCO solver and collect metrics
generate_music_with_jasco: generate music audio from text and symbolic conditions using the JASCO solver run_generate_step
prepare_jasco_latents: prepare audio latents and condition attributes from a batch for JASCO model training
compute_jasco_flow_matching_loss: compute the flow matching loss with configurable weighting for the JASCO model
